source_title: Doubts on the attribution of two blocks to miner Patoshi

observations.statement: The discussion opener disputes attribution of both heights based on a proposed co-spend/common-control inference.
observations.scope: The spending inference is an author assertion; this recovery does not independently revalidate transactions.

observations.statement: The reply considers false positives of the slope-finding algorithm and notes another line crossing the Patoshi slope at 35599.
observations.scope: A classification concern, not a newly verified miner attribution.

observations.statement: The comment disputes height 24504 because its timestamp is 65 seconds after its parent and it intersects another miner extraNonce slope.
observations.scope: The 65-second header difference is independently reproduced; the historical extraNonce-slope assertion was not rerun here.

sensitivity_definition: Remove exactly these three heights from the positive list and treat them as N under original-list nonmembership semantics. Keep original labels unchanged for all primary results.
recovery_method: Inspected the cited original public GitHub discussion; heights were chosen from statements before computing sensitivity, not selected to reproduce a target.
prior_repository_reference: docs/prior-art.md already identified all three heights in its discussion 465 source entry.
frozen_Bitquery_snapshot: Absent from the supplied release ZIP and local attachment inventory; no blocked-domain bypass attempted.
